senses.definition: n.f. a turning aside, defection, apostasy, withdrawal;—always abs. ס׳;—
defection, used appar. of any moral or legal offence Dt 19:16, so prob. Is 59:13 (+ עֹשֶׁק, דִּבְרֵי שָׁ֑קֶר).
apostasy, Dt 13:6 Is 1:5; 31:6 Je 28:16; 29:32.
בִּלְתִּי סָרָה non-withdrawal Is 14:6 (cf. vb., v 25 Am 6:7).
